Use this interactive problem engine to practice and master circuit analysis across **Thévenin & Norton Equivalents**, **First-Order $RC$ & $RL$ Switching Transients (Charging & Discharging)**, **Second-Order Series & Parallel $RLC$ Transients**, **DC Networks (Mesh, Nodal & Dependent Sources)**, **AC Sinusoidal Steady-State (Phasors)**, and **Operational Amplifiers**. 

Select your **Difficulty Tier (Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced)**, verify your numerical calculation using the built-in self-checker, and export ready-to-run **LTspice / TINA-TI netlists** or **Overleaf LaTeX (`circuitikz`)** schematics.
